finding: The 503 POST acknowledgement is not retried. The first reconciliation GET 503 now retries and consumes the held response formerly intended for the second manual attempt. Increasing the UI assertion timeout cannot release that held response.

readOnlyNodeReproduction.scope: Installed PostgrestClient with a synthetic fetch. This is a transport reproduction, not a browser or live-server qualification.

correction: Keep the initial read unavailable for the initial GET and all three automatic retries (four 503 responses). Retry-After: 0 uses the actual SDK retry policy without prolonging the test. Hold only the subsequent read after the explicit user retry.
transportScope: Optional response headers, request method and numerical retryCount only. No policy or timeout override, no real network and no product code change.
assertions: One POST before the explicit user retry
Two POSTs with the same message ID and retryCount 0 after the manual retry
Fifth GET starts at retryCount 0 and remains held until the exact owned row is returned
Existing exact-row filters and single resulting model request remain asserted

preEditImpact.note: Not indexed as a standalone function. File impact and text references checked instead.
